verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a marketing line saying Kommo manages appointments with booking pages and calendars. It does not show syncing an external calendar or meetings appearing on contact and deal timelines, so this is an adjacent built-in scheduling feature rather than the calendar-sync capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync my calendar so meetings appear on contact and deal timelines

citations.quote: Manage appointments from one place — booking pages, calendars, AI scheduling, reminders, and follow-ups included.
